_note: The class SL-089 review M1 is one member of: a root ending in a backslash handed to the app's argv undoubled. Quoted by hand, "C:\" --report "<file>" reaches the app as the one argument C:" --report <file>, so it never enters report mode, writes no report and leaves its window waiting on a person; with two backslashes at the end one is lost. The rule is eng/read-window.ps1's: quote the path and double a trailing backslash run, which tests/window/WindowCases.ps1's Format-AppArgument does for every case. Core.Tests' AppArgumentTests reads this file. roots: the paths a case hands the app, bounded by who produces them (<temp> is a real temp folder, <report> the report path); each must reach the app's argv as [root, --report, report] through the script's own Invoke-HookedRun, and handQuoted says what quoting by hand, as the scripts did before the fix, gave the same root (checked on every run, so the rows the fix closes stay shown). plants: lines the census pattern must find (fire) or pass (quiet). producers: every script in the repository that names the app's exe or launches it, and how it quotes, so a new launcher that is not listed fails the test.
